fields.summary: Birthright employee role: verify selector + Required IT packs
fields.description: Confirm Meridian birthright business role (e.g. MNB-Birthright-Employee) has an assignment selector for active employees and Required Roles pointing at agreed IT packs (not privileged CloudAdmin). Use list_agent_roles / get role detail; if selector or requirements are wrong, fix via set_role_selector / set_role_requirements. Run Identity Refresh and sample one joiner identity for role membership. Evidence under .ai-delivery/MNB-126/.
